failure_or_lesson: A single correction story cannot show selective learning. A pilot fixture must also include an irrelevant correction and an outcome case while keeping source IDs, before/after histories, and the scoring discussion separate from any claimed model result.
goal: Prepare a fictional multi-year pilot input for the FloRA behavioral comparison without treating it as held-out evidence or a real host history.
notes: Pilot content is public and may be used to build the harness; sealed held-out cases and thresholds await pilot calibration.
procedure: Draft fictional years-long source events; declare three interventions with exact before/after source lists and public development rubrics; validate chronology, distinct sources, unchanged baseline, and intervention lineage; do not use this as held-out evidence or imply a model passed.
validation: Selected-backend run 36612501266 passed two-stage isolated KurrentDB/opaque raw ingestion for relevant, irrelevant and outcome cases, including formation input before intervention and refusal to replay the intervention twice. No model run or behavioral score.
